_comment: REAL-TIME replay tier. Drives the real-time engine (RealTimeEngine -> SBF decode -> processEpoch -> state_trace) via deterministic FILE REPLAY of a frozen SBF capture, with PRECISE products (COD MGX final), then grades the converged position vs an INDEPENDENT frozen site coordinate (data/static/sites/covl.json, consumed nowhere in the engine). This is the position-accuracy regression guard for the RT pipeline; stream-level invariants position-grading cannot see (SSR saw-tooth, obs<->SSR sync, GLONASS TOD, sat-bias SSR-blindness) are covered by C++ gtests (tests/test_realtime_seams.cpp). PREREQUISITE: the SBF fixture (data/sbf/covl1452.26_) and COD MGX final products for 2026-145 staged under data_download.data_root.

cells._comment: A/B: select the multi-GNSS LEIAR25.R4 NONE ATX block (native Galileo E1/E5a PCO/PCV) vs the base LEIAR25 NONE (GPS-L1/L2-only -> Galileo via cross-system fallback to L2). Quantifies the Galileo antenna-fallback effect on position.
